title: Ketan Murder Case: Understanding the Gray Area
summary: The Ketan Murder case has sparked debate about the gray area between murder and self-defense. The police claim that the crime was pre-planned, while the accused, Siya Goyal, remains silent. The investigation is ongoing, with the court set to review the case next.
summary_points: The Ketan Murder case involves allegations of pre-planned murder by Siya Goyal.
The police claim that the crime was pre-planned and that Siya Goyal had a motive to harm Ketan Aggarwal.
Siya Goyal remains silent, despite being questioned by the police.
The investigation is ongoing, with the court set to review the case next.
